items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: George McCollum left the band when his wife was going to have a kid and then he was sent for Alvin Alcorn.

ctx.x: We got to get who was in the band, too, before we leave. Who else was in it? Did you have any changes? You must have. Oh, we had lots of changes.

Because when we, I can't tell you the exact places where we hadn't had the changes. Because I think we sent for Warren and Edgar one time. That's right. And Warren left me in, how did it come? Boy, it's been so long. George McCollum left the band when his wife was going to have a kid and then he was sent for Alvin Alcorn. Alvin Alcorn, that's right. I think that was in Wayne, Nebraska. I think it was Wayne, Nebraska. Not positive.
